purpose: Recheck of /home/hous/dev/qwen3.5-35b-a3b/memory-layout-handoff.json stage_3 sections against the final Stage-3 source, using live allocator totals and a root-UID census.
method: tests/weight_inventory.py: construct the DEFAULT_POLICIES layer on one Blackhole chip (1x1 mesh), walk the Python object graph, group device tensors by buffer_unique_id, payload = buffer_num_pages * buffer_page_size, plus ttnn.get_memory_view DRAM allocator total.

findings.handoff_item: Outer shallow-copied BF8 per-expert lists retained (packed prefill policy)
findings.evidence: Selected prefill_backend is 'dispatch', not 'packed'. Dispatch owns 768 per-expert roots of dtype ['DataType.BFLOAT8_B'] (816.0 MiB) plus maps; these are the selected prefill consumer, not stale copies.

findings.handoff_item: Same-dtype ttnn.typecast copies of sparse decode weights (560 MiB)
findings.evidence: _as_dtype aliases same-dtype weights. Census: one gate_up BFP4 [1,256,2048,1024] (288 MiB) and one down BFP8 [1,256,512,2048] (272 MiB) root; no second copy.

findings.handoff_item: Two routed representations (decode stacked + prefill dispatch lists)
findings.evidence: Decode sparse_matmul reads stacked tensors; moe_fused_swiglu reads per-expert lists and requires one dtype for gate/up/down (TT_FATAL moe_fused_swiglu_device_operation.cpp:142). Sharing needs an op change. Expert-parallel sharding in Stage 4 divides both by the expert-parallel degree.
Linear BF16 output_weight (16 MiB) and full q/k/v_proj BFP8 (19.1 MiB) are released when optimized projections own the consumers (review2/inventory/pre_release_*.json versus final).

32 configured slots per linear layer, independent of active batch: FP32 TILE [1,32,128,128] 2 MiB each in DRAM plus conv history BF16 ROW_MAJOR [1,3,8192] 48 KiB each. gdn_state_l1 is off; gdn_l1 only moves single-token intermediates.
Each full-attention decoder owns cos/sin BF16 [262144,64] (64.0 MiB). Ten full layers would hold ten identical copies unless the full model shares one.

capacity_implication.forty_layer_estimate_note: 30 linear + 10 full layers; module caches and one RoPE table counted once; test KV excluded. Excludes embedding, LM head, KV cache, trace and activation buffers. Does not fit one chip; the p150 profile needs expert placement or precision changes in later stages.
